content.short: Tevaera offers on-chain gaming infrastructure and a suite of fun, fair games.
content.description: Tevaera's gaming ecosystem comprises two core offerings: on-chain gaming infrastructure and fun, fair games. The infrastructure addresses integration challenges for on-chain games by providing a secure, decentralized, and scalable environment that enables fun and fair play. For example, a Unity-based front-end game can be connected to an on-chain matchmaker, a first-of-its-kind integration that hasn’t been solved on any other blockchain platform yet. Together, these elements give developers a robust foundation to build engaging, trustworthy blockchain games without compromising player experience.
content.meta: Tevaera is building a next-generation EVM-compatible gaming ecosystem. Discover Tevaera and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
